{"page":"docs/site-src/core/infrastructure/api-pod-security-hardening.md","verdict":"contradiction","findings":[{"claim":"A mount broken by over-restrictive settings fails loudly at pod start and blocks readiness. It does not fail quietly later. That property made `api` the first workload for validating the approach.","source_path":"docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-security-remediation-group-b.md","evidence":"The plan says the reverse. Task 1 states the api pod \"fails its first credential operation if that mount is broken — a 500 on connector and destination-DB routes, not a boot failure\". The commit message text says \"a broken mount does not fail the pod - it fails the first credential operation\". It also says api is the pilot because \"its failure mode is the quietest\", so verification must read a credential path and not only pod readiness."}]}
